name: Cherry Ink
notes: Cherry, Bergamot, Black Pepper, Rum Accord, Sour Cherry, Red Wine, Damask Rose, Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley, Mimosa, Warm Spices, Ink, Myrrh, Vanilla Bean, Tonka Bean, Precious Woods, Patchouli, Benzoin, Amber, Musk, Agarwood
description: An extraordinary, avant-garde cherry fragrance, whose key note, along with its sister scent, sour cherry, is interlaced with the unusual note of ink, breathing life into something seductive, deep, dark and meditative. The boozy counterpart of rum and red wine lends instant warmth to the fruity notes, leading right up to the amber and woody grand finale.

name: Van Py Rhum
notes: Vanilla, Bourbon Vanilla, Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka, Tahitian Vanilla, Mohea Vanilla, Rum, Vanilla Islands Vanilla, White Flowers, Caramel, Patchouli, Agarwood, Indonesian Patchouli, Oak Barrel Rum, Black Vanilla Husk
description: Drops of rum glide over a bed of soft vanilla. This mellow music is one of shadowy Patchouli dancing, white flowers all around, in a sigh that tells a story of warm elegance. Vanilla lovers, rejoice- this smooth, boozy vanilla uses an impressive blend of the world's finest vanillas to create an impossibly well-rounded, simply stunning fragrance showcasing every aspect of this beloved ingredient.
label: Amber_Oriental

name: Pax
notes: Citrus, Pear, Passionfruit, Black Grape, Pepper, Magnolia, Jasmine, Cardamom, Cassis Leaf, Cassis Bud, Incense, Amber, Vanilla, White Musk, Agarwood
description: Pax is an olfactory self-portrait used by Lorenzo Pazzaglia to show his true self, his culinary art and personality. Juxtaposed, contrasting notes piece together the myriad sides of a multifaceted person. The sparkling, cordial opening of citrus and pepper paves the way to a heart of fruity notes whose sweetness is tempered by a crystalline incense. Precious woods and leather provide an unexpected backdrop for a bouquet of white flowers with fruity and spicy nuances. Every note, every raw ingredient used, is a hidden symbol, but also a key.
label: Amber_Oriental
